title: Resteigne Halifax Memorial
location_name: Place de l'Église, Resteigne, Luxembourg Province, Belgium
memorial_details: Newly dedicated information panel near the church at Resteigne, remembering three local wartime crashes including one Bomber Command loss.
narrative: Halifax W7913 of 102 Squadron, coded DY-C, departed Pocklington at 0145 on 3 December 1942 for Frankfurt. The aircraft was intercepted at 4500m over Resteigne by Unteroffizier Dieter Ericsen of 2/NJG4 and shot down at 0355, his first claim. The aircraft crashed at Les Brulins. All eight crew were killed. The memorial information panel at Resteigne remembers three local wartime crashes, of which W7913 is the Bomber Command loss.
cause_of_loss: Shot down by night fighter — Uffz Dieter Ericsen (2/NJG4), his 1st claim
